notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.9.10 is live! 🎉
notes.notes:
⚖ Combat: Combat effects that change hit/defense ratings now have increased impact.
⚖ Combat: "Lacerate" combat ability has been tweaked. It now applies Charging to self (instead of Exposed to enemy) and now also triggers Deep Cuts.
⚖ Combat: "Fatigued" has been reworked. It no longer affects hit rating but instead increases ability cooldowns. Moves that apply "Fatigued" have been adjusted.
⚖ Combat: Adjusted the effectiveness of many combat abilities, very often increasing their effectiveness on higher tier items.
⚖ Combat: Polearms now have an additional mechanic around a Momentum effect.
⚖ Combat: Swords have the Riposte reworked and gain a new ability: Cross over.
⚖ "Awareness" power now includes estimating the odds that you score a hit with your attacks.

notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.9.5 is live! 🎉
notes.notes:
🛠 Fixed an issue where elite mob drops would continue to show "Decoration" in the name, even when that part was previously named.
⚙ Travelling now shows speed even when no skill is involved.
⚙ Unlocked Powers in Collections menu are now clickable.
⚙ Invitees list will now show if invitee's character is currently dead.
⚙ Combat moves that do not interrupt fleeing not indicate this in their description.
⚙ Updated the layout of the Server Info screen, making it more compact and including additional information about the numbers shown.

notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.9.4 is live! 🎉
notes.notes: 🆕 When you own more than one home you now have an option to specifically choose which home you get the benefits of decorations from.

notes.title: Version 1.9.3 is live!
notes.notes: ⚙ Fixed an issue where under rare, specific circumstances combat could result in turns being executed instantly.

notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.9.2 is live! 🎉
notes.notes:
⚖ Elite monster reaching extremely high levels will now be gaining considerably less power. In addition to that their Resistances will be much more interactable. Please note that this change won't be retroactive and the really tough monsters roaming the land right now will retain their power.
🛠 Fixed an issue where when carrying exactly one weapon it couldn't be unequipped in combat.
🛠 Ruined structures will no longer occasionally display stacked with non-ruined structures of the same type on the structures list.
⚙ Updated names regarding certain researches focused on ores.
⚙ When swapping weapons in combat you will now get a list of combat moves each weapon provides.
⚙ Effects of similar type are now sorted alphabetically.

notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.9.0 is live! 🎉
notes.notes: 🆕 Hostile creatures may now gain Elite ranks. Gaining Elite ranks is always linked to players and their activity, but the exact way this works is left for players to discover. Elite ranks provide monsters with additional bonuses, all of which are always listed explicitly on the creature. Killing an Elite creature will grant additional rewards.

notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.8.8 is live! 🎉
notes.notes:
🛠️ Fixed an issue where certain combat moves did not include Deep Cuts as they should have.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where the same Quick Action under different labels would not be displayed but would still count against the limit of Quick Actions.
⚙ Updated the Power List interface to help better fit all the text there.

notes.title: Version 1.8.7 is live!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Fixed an issue where one of the new buildings was not placeable where expected.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where Observer mode checkboxes would sometimes misbehave.
⚙ When inside a building the environment panel now lists the building, enabling you to see the owner of the building.

notes.title: Version 1.8.6 is live!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Ensure that the look of the completed trades is consistent.
⚙ When your blood loss drops you will now always get a warning screen.
⚙ Updated the farming interface.

notes.title: Version 1.8.5 is live!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Fixed some miscellaneous issues around Chapter 2 threat behaviour.
⚙ Added "remove all notifications" button when any notifications are shown.
⚙ Cleaned up number "1" shown next to every character in the creatures panel.

notes.title: Version 1.8.2 is live!
notes.notes:
🆕 It is now possible to transfer building ownership using direct trading.
🛠️ When you offer an item to another player in a trade you accepted - when any of these items decay your acceptance of the trade will remain in place.
⚙ Improved navigation for Server Statistics.
⚙ Connected players number now shows the distinct connected players.
⚙ Server Statistics and Changelog were merged together into Server Info.

notes.title: Version 1.8.1 is live!
notes.notes:
🆕 Added a new statistics screen that shows some information about player count and server uptime.
🛠️ "Distracted" effect now lasts the intended duration.

notes.title: Version 1.8.0 is live!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Drastically improved the loading time for large towns.
⚙ Shop interface was updated. Listings that are fully sold/supplied now stay on the list until dismissed. Owners can now see a list of customers for their "Buy" listings as well as "Sell" listings. When selling an item you can now select which specific item you want to sell if you have items with different quality or durability.

notes.title: Version 1.7.0 is live!
notes.notes:
⚖️ Road durability has been increased, with lower tier roads getting considerably bigger increase. This also affects maintenance cost, reducing it for all roads.
⚖️ Speed bonus from roads has been increased.
🛠️ Several areas of Chapter 2 that look like they should include access to water will now include it.
🛠️ Fishing spots are now correctly included in Chapter 2 lands.
🛠️ Fixed the description of Shield researches.
🛠️ Shield inspiration unlock is no longer tied to an unrelated item.
⚙ You can now specify a label when adding a quick action.

notes.title: Version 1.6.0 is live!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Fixed an issue where sentry mode would fail to register item pickups and drops under certain, very common, circumstances.
⚙ Research problem notes now include in description an indicator if they are already known by you.

notes.title: Version 1.5.0 is live!
notes.notes:
:scales: Increased the amount of Action Points it takes to progress the stages of Dirty.
:scales: Underground caves now include additional environmental effect causing increased Dirtying. Coupled with the above players who spend time exclusively underground won't see much of a difference than before these changes.
:scales: Death Defied applied due to vitality loss will now add more vitality based on character age.

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 is live!
notes.notes: 🆕 Introducing: Observer Mode. Enter observer mode by clicking your character in top left corner and select "Observer Mode". Pick what type of events you want to look for and the game will automatically fill in a log that will tell you what happened around you while the Observer Mode was on.

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 is live!
notes.notes:
⚖️ Slightly reduced skill requirements for milestone "Mastery: Martial".
🛠️ Skills self-applying Fatigued incorrectly applied it for 2 turns. They will now apply it for 1 turn.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where abandoning a house would not kick everyone out.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where Blood Loss estimate would show sometimes show outdated value.
🛠️ Characters that are invited under current name to your house now longer show as option to add to invites list.
🛠️ Redecorating your house no longer shows ruined items as a valid choice for selection. This is an interface fix only, it was not possible to put up ruined items as decorations already.
⚙ Blood Loss estimate will no longer show estimates when they are going into millions of Action Points, replaced with a more generic message instead.
⚙ Total Stealth multiplier is now shown as part of your Defense panel.
⚙ When selecting an item for an action, like trading, will now show you the name of the selected item.
⚙ Light sources no longer use up durability when equipped while not affected by Darkness. Please note that any Darkness level at all will continue to trigger durability being used, even if some powers or other effects negate it sufficiently.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 is live
notes.notes:
⚖️ Combat strength of a specific creature has been reduced.
⚖️ Most combat moves that apply Readied or Focused now apply more stacks.
🖼️ Character equipment is now displayed on the character.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
⚖️ Durability of several tools were adjusted. More advanced tools had their durability increased when used as tools.
⚖️ Duration of light sources was slightly increased. 
⚖️ Damage of higher tier sword weapons has been slightly increased.
